principle: No Factory02 entry, stop, target or trailing may participate in native Drummond economics.

timeframe_contract.note: Fixed hierarchy for this experiment; no opportunistic timeframe switching.

setup_families.name: TREND_REFRESH
setup: PL Dot push is in trend direction
setup_families.trigger: Price enters Live/Static PL Dot Refresh zone and subsequently resumes in trend direction.
setup_families.initial_target: Nearby HTP zone in direction of trade
setup_families.extended_target: Further Out HTP if Nearby weakens
setup_families.initial_stop: Beyond LTP Further Out opposite the trade

setup_families.name: CONGESTION_ACTION
setup: HTP is not in a directional trend against the fade
Boundary is classified strong from HTP context
setup_families.trigger: Confirmed hold of strong block/support for LONG or strong dotted/resistance for SHORT.
setup_families.initial_stop: Beyond LTP Further Out outside the defended boundary

setup_families.name: EXHAUST_REVERSAL
setup: Trend penetrates Nearby and reaches Further Out
HTP is also mature/exhausting or losing PL Dot push
setup_families.trigger: Conservative: Further Out holds and price begins returning toward PL Dot.
setup_families.initial_target: PL Dot Refresh zone, then opposite envelope boundary

setup_families.name: CONGESTION_EXIT
setup: One boundary holds while the opposite boundary weakens/breaks
setup_families.trigger: Confirmed boundary break / new Trend Run.
setup_families.extended_target: Further Out HTP if Nearby weakens

setup_families.name: WEAK_BLOCK_BREAK
setup: Block classified weak from HTP pressure
setup_families.trigger: Conservative: confirmed block break and beginning of trend.
setup_families.extended_target: Further Out HTP if Nearby weakens

stop.rule: Stop beyond current-period Further Out; trail only in favorable direction as Further Out moves.

flow_exit.rule: Exit before structural stop when flow against the position becomes good / flow in position direction deteriorates.

target.rule: Primary target Nearby HTP; if Nearby weakens, extend to Further Out HTP.

pyramiding.rule: Add on Live PL Dot Refresh while power/flow remains favorable.

operationalization_policy.qualitative_rules: Enumerate small predeclared variants and report all variants.

source_gaps: Exact numeric ET/EB formula beyond recovered proxy
Exact author maximum pyramid layer count
forbidden: Factory02 signal IDs as entry triggers
Using SOURCE_GAP concepts as exact gates
